diagnosis: All four rollouts passed Check C1 (rollout approved) despite none of them having access to PF1, which dictates the initial traffic percent and rollback threshold. This suggests that the model is defaulting to conservative settings like a 25% initial traffic percentage and a 500ms rollback threshold, which are easy thresholds to meet without needing the hidden information.
